purpose: Operational procedure for five-paper summary-writer calibration batches.
preflight: Read AGENTS.md, coordination/tasks/agent-e-paper-summaries.md, coordination/directives/summary-accuracy-first-policy.json, this procedure, and the agent-specific assignment and directive completely.
Verify the assignment target_agent, paper_count, and canonical paper-ID SHA-256 before editing.

For each assigned paper, confirm that local metadata title and official PDF URL exactly match the assignment, metadata and relevance workflows are READY_FOR_REVIEW, relevance class is CORE_SYSTEMS or SYSTEMS_ADJACENT, and summary workflow is NOT_STARTED.
If any preflight fact differs, do not edit that paper and report the mismatch to the coordinator.
claim_rules: Create only the agent-specific claim file named in the directive by copying the claim template.
Use the exact agent ID, role paper-summary-calibration, status IN_PROGRESS, summary.json as the sole stage file, and exactly the five assigned paper IDs.
Do not edit coordination/claims/agent-e.json or another writer's claim.
exclusive_write_scope: Temporary ignored files under data/tmp/<agent-id>/, removed after extraction.
source_and_reading_rules: Use the staged official PDF as the primary source. Do not substitute metadata prose, an abstract page, search snippets, another summary, or an AI-generated explanation.
Record the PDF SHA-256 and an official paper-pdf source entry.
Read the abstract, introduction, conclusion, central system/design section, and evaluation overview.
Read any additional section, figure, or table necessary to verify a mechanism, assumption, baseline, limitation, or result included in the summary.
Record exact sections read in workflow notes and mark reading coverage truthfully.
If the official full paper cannot be obtained, set the summary workflow to BLOCKED and report it; do not write from partial evidence.
technical_claim_ledger: Add a source-linked claim entry for the central mechanism.
Add a source-linked claim entry for each material assumption or trust boundary stated in the summary.
Every quantitative evaluation result must appear in evaluation.results and have an exact page, section, figure, or table locator.
Use at most two quantitative results unless a third is essential to prevent a misleading impression.
Do not use a vague locator such as paper, PDF, evaluation, or abstract.
self_audit_before_handoff: Reopen the official PDF and compare every sentence in takeaway, villain, approach, impact, evaluation, and limitations against the cited sections.
Check that names of mechanisms, components, baselines, hardware, datasets, workloads, threat models, and study types exactly match the paper.
Recalculate no metrics and combine no numbers unless the paper explicitly reports the same calculation.
Check every number, unit, comparison direction, quantifier, and experimental condition.
Remove any claim that is broader or more certain than the paper.
Prefer null or an explicit unresolved note over a plausible guess.
handoff: Set completed summary workflows to READY_FOR_REVIEW with the writer as owner and verification.verified_by null.
Run draft validation for each affected venue-year and for data/shards.
After all five summaries are ready or explicitly blocked, update the agent-specific claim with the exact outcome and no additional IDs.
Report sections read, PDF hashes, blocked or uncertain fields, exact changed paths, validator output, and confirmation that temporary PDFs and extracted text were removed.
Stop after the five-paper calibration batch. Do not select or request another paper automatically.
